reason: The PR primarily replaces exhaustive route selection in crossover greedy repair with a nearest-centroid route choice, reducing insertion evaluations per unplanned client. This task evaluates that CVRP solver path. The same PR also changes time-window insertion-cost accounting, which this CVRP task does not claim to measure.
solver_behavior_hypothesis: Restricting greedy repair to a nearby route can reduce the number of insertion evaluations per unplanned client, but can miss a better route and worsen the search population or final route cost.
causal_chain: The old repair scans insertion positions in every nonempty route; the PR computes route centroids, chooses one nearby route per unplanned client, and scans only that route. For time-window cases it also changes the insertion penalty estimate. This changes crossover cost and offspring quality, which can redirect later evolutionary search.
structural_trigger: A CVRP crossover repair with at least one unplanned client and at least two nonempty routes; a single-route case or no unplanned clients is the control. The separate time-window delta-cost branch is outside this task.
activation_probe: Count greedy-repair entries, unplanned clients, nonempty candidate routes, insertion evaluations, selected route and resulting child objective in paired pinned builds; include a no-repair or single-route control and a separate time-window trigger.
instance_selection_rule: Freeze CVRP public cases by location count, active route count and baseline difficulty before hidden scoring; retain multi-route/unplanned triggers and single-route or no-unplanned controls, fixed seeds and budgets, and all failures.
workload_exposure_plan: Use the shared PyVRP anytime driver on frozen CVRP cases, trace crossover greedyRepair when multiple routes and unplanned clients are present, and independently verify original routing solutions.
mathematical_risk: The route restriction can select a different feasible insertion and worsen cost; route updates could also duplicate or omit clients or violate capacity. The time-window penalty branch is not exercised by this CVRP task and is not part of its claim.
independent_check_plan: Verify every returned CVRP route against original customer coverage, uniqueness, capacity and objective, then compare paired quality-time trajectories across location counts and route counts.
hidden_generalization_plan: Measure paired normalized gap at declared budgets on held-out CVRP instances stratified by location count and route count, including severe quality and runtime regressions.
overlap_review: This 2023 centroid-based CVRP greedy-repair change precedes PyVRP #511 and later search-state changes. The PR also contains a separate time-window cost branch, which this CVRP task leaves unmeasured and explicitly does not claim. The source PR remains one task.
resource_risk: Cheaper crossover can increase the number of generations, while lower-quality repaired offspring can require more search or degrade final quality despite fewer insertion evaluations.
